title: Read the platform's health
description: From Home, open Platform health, read the build and its uptime, then open the lab node's row onto its platform component to see its check-in age.

steps.caption: Home's Platform tile carries the platform's verdict and how many nodes are not up.
The build, its uptime and the verdict, each read from the platform's own components.
One row per node. A figure the node never reported reads not reported, never 0.
A node is a component of the platform system. Open its row.
The node's platform component, the same detail as any device. Its check-in age is a series like any other metric.
